llmResponse.agenda_changes: Item 10.1 (Trustee Candidate Presentations and Appointment, Area III) was moved to follow item 8.1 (Approval of Agenda). Instead of taking a 2-hour presentations block, 20-minute break, then another 2-hour block, the board decided to hear all 10 candidate presentations consecutively, then take a single 20-minute break before voting.
